name: Stereo width
description: Makes stereo sound narrower or wider: 0 is mono, 1 leaves it exactly as it is, 2 doubles the difference between left and right. Can also swap the two channels. Sound that is not stereo is left as it is.

params.label: Width
params.description: How far apart left and right are: 0 makes the sound mono, 1 leaves it as it is, 2 doubles the difference between the channels.

params.label: Swap left and right
params.description: On: the left and right channels change places, after the width is applied.
